name: Katlyn Cerminara
event: UFC Fight Night: Buckley vs. Malott
summary: The former Katlyn Chookagian (18-6): a long, high-volume point fighter and 2020 flyweight title challenger who won 11 UFC fights, all by decision. She hasn't fought since losing to Maycee Barber in March 2024 (two straight losses), stepped away for motherhood, and returns after about 31 months against short-notice newcomer Mackenzie Stiller, in her first camp at Marquez MMA in Philadelphia.

how_they_fight.Striking: Range kickboxing on volume: 4.9 significant strikes a minute with long jabs, straight shots and kicks, low power (one knockdown in 17 UFC fights, vs. Joanne Wood, per our data). Out-landed most opponents at distance (e.g., 105-84 over Irene Aldana) but was out-struck by Manon Fiorot (98-76) when the opponent had the better tools.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Mostly defensive. Rarely takes people down (5 of 32 UFC attempts, per our data) though she has ridden top position on occasion (Ribas, Araujo, Maia). Last submission came in 2015.
how_they_fight.Defense: Good distance management and stamina, but breaks down when opponents get inside. Stopped twice: by Jessica Andrade's body shots at 4:55 of R1 (2020) and by Valentina Shevchenko at 1:03 of R3 (2020). Barber went 4 for 4 on takedowns and won with clinch pressure.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: A pure slow burner who goes 15 minutes: 15 of her 18 wins are decisions, every UFC win included. Her last finish was in 2016 (Bragayrac, R1 KO). Both stoppage losses came after opponents closed distance (R1 and R3). Never visibly fades; wins by banking rounds.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Disciplined and consistent; plays the judges with output and range. Struggles to change gears when a bigger, more physical opponent forces clinches.

patterns: Decision fighter: 15 of 18 wins on the cards, all 11 UFC wins
Volume striking at long range, jab and kicks
Close fights: four of her UFC bouts were split decisions (2-2 in them)
Loses to pressure and grappling: Barber (clinch and takedowns), Fiorot, Andrade (body shots)
concerns: About 31 months out of action; age 38 per our data (37 per SI)
Two-fight losing streak; last win in May 2022
First camp at a new gym (Marquez MMA)
Opponent swap from Jamey-Lyn Horth to a short-notice newcomer with a very different (grappling) style
keys_to_beat: Close the distance and work the body
Clinch against the fence and take her down late in rounds
Don't trade at range; she wins the points battle there

news.text: Booked to return against Jamey-Lyn Horth at UFC Edmonton, ending a roughly two-and-a-half-year layoff.
Horth withdrew with an injury; TUF 34 cast member Mackenzie Stiller replaces her on less than three weeks' notice.
Home of Fight interview: her first camp at Marquez MMA in Philadelphia, after becoming a mother and recovering from pregnancy.
Official weigh-in: 125 lb for the women's flyweight bout; no misses reported on the card.
